project.name: Lumen Markdown
project.distribution: Portable unpackaged ZIP, framework-dependent .NET, self-contained Windows App SDK, unsigned
project.persistence: JSON settings and recent files via System.Text.Json; no database
project.note: Planning artifact only. No phase has been executed. Commands are instructions for later implementation.

userDecisions.UD-1: Balanced reader and editor: split live preview, syntax highlighting, open/save
userDecisions.UD-4: Greenfield; no existing code or assets; placeholder branding
userDecisions.UD-5: No database; JSON settings and recent files

phases.name: Prerequisites and technical spike
phases.outcome: A machine that builds and launches a minimal WinUI 3 window, plus evidence for self-contained Windows App SDK, the editor control, and WebView2 messaging.
phases.runnableSlice: Blank window titled 'Lumen Markdown' that launches from dotnet run and from a published folder.
tasks: Verify or install SDK 10.0.403 or relax global.json
Create solution, App, Core and Core.Tests projects
Set TFM, x64, WindowsPackageType None, WindowsAppSDKSelfContained true
Add global.json, Directory.Build.props, Directory.Packages.props
Spike A: publish and launch on a machine without Windows App Runtime
Spike B: TextControlBox with 5000 lines and Narrator
Spike C: WebView2 loads bundled HTML and receives one message
Write docs/spike-notes.md with verdicts and exact versions
commands: dotnet publish src/LumenMarkdown.App -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -p:Platform=x64 -p:WindowsPackageType=None -p:WindowsAppSDKSelfContained=true -o artifacts/spike
verification: Window opens, resizes and closes cleanly
Published folder launches on a clean Windows 11 x64 machine without the Windows App Runtime
Editor spike accepts 5000 lines without multi-second freeze and is exposed as editable text to Narrator
WebView2 spike displays bundled HTML and logs one received message
Spike verdicts recorded in docs/spike-notes.md
phases.exitCriteria: All three spikes have written verdicts and the published blank app launches on the clean VM.

userValidationGate.prompt: Run artifacts/spike/LumenMarkdown.exe on a clean Windows 11 x64 machine and confirm the window opens.

phases.name: Shell and window
phases.outcome: The real window chrome, theme, empty state and command surface, with no file I/O.
phases.runnableSlice: App opens to the start surface; layout toggle and theme switch work; commands are correctly enabled.
tasks: Build MainWindow XAML: title bar, command bar, split document area, status bar
Add MainViewModel with observable base and relay commands
Add ThemeService and SettingsStore skeleton
Add EditorPane around TextBox and PreviewPane placeholder
Build start surface with drop zone, Open, empty recents, shortcut hints
Wire keyboard accelerators and layout cycling
Persist and restore window geometry and splitter ratio
Add rolling file logger and global exception handler
verification: Window restores size, position and maximised state
Ctrl+Shift+P cycles three layouts and splitter ratio persists
Theme switch applies immediately and persists
Open, Save and Find are disabled with no document
Deleting settings.json and relaunching falls back to defaults without a crash
200 percent text scale shows no clipped command labels
phases.exitCriteria: Settings round-trip works, layout and theme persist, and a 10-minute resize/theme session produces no unhandled exception.

userValidationGate.prompt: Confirm the visual shell matches the UX manual closely enough to build on, and approve placeholder branding.

phases.name: Open and read
phases.outcome: A real Markdown file opens from picker, drag-drop and command line, and renders faithfully.
phases.runnableSlice: Open README.md and read it rendered; editor shows raw source read-only.
tasks: Implement TextFileLoader with encoding detection, binary rejection and size guard
Implement FilePickerService with InitializeWithWindow
Implement DocumentSession state machine with hash-based dirty state
Implement MarkdownRenderer with Markdig advanced extensions and DisableHtml
Build preview shell template, preview.css and CSP; resolve relative paths via base href
Wire drop target, command-line argument and File Open
Detect read-only files and show badge
Add encoding, HTML escaping and extension unit tests
verification: 1 MB README renders headings, tables, task lists, code fences and quotes correctly
CRLF and LF files display without doubled blank lines
UTF-8 BOM file shows no BOM characters
Relative image resolves against document folder; missing image shows alt text
Opening an .exe shows a clear binary-file message
Read-only file shows badge and Save disabled
phases.exitCriteria: All fixture files render with expected structure and every error state has a visible message.

userValidationGate.prompt: Open three of your own Markdown files and confirm rendering fidelity, especially tables, code blocks and relative images.

phases.name: Edit and live preview
phases.outcome: Editing with an updating preview that preserves scroll, focus and responsiveness.
phases.runnableSlice: Type in the left pane and watch the right pane follow within 300 ms.
tasks: Make editor editable with guarded two-way binding
Implement 250 ms debounced render with generation numbers and one in-flight render
Wire WebView2 bridge: NavigateToString first load, PostWebMessageAsString updates
Preserve scroll ratio and editor caret across updates
Cancel renders on document switch and window close
Implement hash-based dirty state and title/status updates
Propagate theme to preview without reloading
Add renderer determinism and debounce coalescing tests
verification: Typing updates preview after pause without flicker or scroll jump
Holding a key for 5 seconds keeps UI responsive; preview settles on release
Scrolling mid-edit keeps preview at the same relative position
Theme change does not reload the document or lose the caret
No ObjectDisposedException in logs when closing mid-render
Measured p95 keystroke-to-preview is 300 ms or less on a 100 KB document
phases.exitCriteria: Measured keystroke-to-preview p95 <= 300 ms and no stale render overwrites a newer one.

userValidationGate.prompt: Edit a real document for five minutes and confirm the preview feels live and the caret never jumps.

phases.name: Syntax highlighting and editing UX
phases.outcome: Markdown source highlighting, line numbers, find, go-to-line, and a final editor control decision.
phases.runnableSlice: Open a document and see coloured Markdown with a line gutter; Ctrl+F finds text.
tasks: Score TextControlBox and RichEditBox against stability, performance, accessibility and licence
Implement IEditorAdapter and bind the chosen control with the other as fallback
Add line-number gutter and current-line highlight
Implement Markdown token classifier and theme brushes
Build find bar with match count, next/previous, case toggle and Esc restore
Build go-to-line input with validation
Add debounced word count and caret line/column
Verify accelerators with IME and RTL text
Add token classifier and find wrap-around tests
verification: Headings, bold, links, inline code and fenced code are visually distinct in both themes
Gutter numbers align with lines and wrapping is clearly indicated
Find reports correct counts, wraps, and Esc restores the caret
Go-to-line rejects 0, non-numeric and out-of-range values
Narrator reads editor content and announces selection
Pasting 1 MB completes without a UI freeze longer than 1 second
phases.exitCriteria: Chosen editor passes accessibility and 1 MB checks; token fixtures pass; fallback approved if no third-party control qualifies.

userValidationGate.prompt: Review the highlighting palette and find/go-to-line behaviour and accept or reject the editor control decision.

phases.name: Save, recent files and recovery
phases.outcome: A complete document lifecycle: save, Save As, dirty prompts, recents, external-change detection and draft recovery.
phases.runnableSlice: Edit, save, restart, reopen from recents, recover after a forced kill.
tasks: Implement atomic TextFileWriter preserving encoding and line endings
Implement Save and Save As with picker defaults
Implement dirty-close prompt on window close, document close and open-over-current
Implement recent files with dedupe, cap, pruning and persistence
Detect external changes with FileSystemWatcher and timestamp comparison
Implement 60-second draft autosave and recovery prompt
Add settings schema migration and corruption backup
Add atomic write, dirty transition, recents and recovery tests
verification: Ctrl+S writes the file, clears the dirty dot and preserves line endings
Save As updates title and recents
Close with edits offers Save, Discard and Cancel; Cancel keeps the caret
Forced kill followed by relaunch offers and restores the draft
External edit while open shows the stale banner
Deleted recent file shows Not found and is removed
Corrupt settings.json backs up and starts with defaults
phases.exitCriteria: Every save, close and recovery path behaves as described with no data loss in the forced-kill test.

userValidationGate.prompt: Perform a full edit, save, close and reopen cycle on your own file and confirm no content or line-ending damage.

phases.name: Hardening and performance
phases.outcome: The app survives ugly inputs and meets the non-functional targets.
phases.runnableSlice: Full feature set running against the stress corpus without crashes or unacceptable latency.
tasks: Build stress corpus: 1 MB, 10 MB, 50k lines, deep nesting, wide tables, malformed Markdown, emoji, RTL
Fix rendering cliffs with nesting/table limits and preview throttling
Measure NFR-01 to NFR-05 and record docs/performance.md
Audit memory: WebView2 disposal, event unsubscription, session leaks
Run accessibility audit and high-contrast check
Run DPI matrix and mixed-monitor drag test
Inject failures: read-only folder, disk full, locked file, missing WebView2
Run 30-minute soak script
Fix P1/P2 defects and log P3s for v1.1
verification: 1 MB opens in 1 second or less with no typing lag and memory at or below 350 MB
10 MB warns and opens read-only while remaining usable
Malformed Markdown renders as text without exceptions
High-contrast theme keeps all text readable and focus visible
Dragging between 100 and 200 percent monitors does not blur or clip
Soak run leaves no errors in the log
phases.exitCriteria: NFR-01 to NFR-05 measured within target, accessibility audit has no blockers, soak run clean.

userValidationGate.prompt: Run the stress files on your hardware and accept the measured performance or name the case that must improve.

phases.name: Packaging and release
phases.outcome: A signed-off portable ZIP that runs on a clean Windows 11 x64 machine.
phases.runnableSlice: Unzip on a clean VM, launch, open and save a file, close.
tasks: Produce Release publish with unpackaged and self-contained WinAppSDK properties
Add manifest with PerMonitorV2, longPathAware and version info
Trim publish output and verify required native DLLs
Create ZIP with README, LICENSE, third-party notices and changelog
Compute SHA-256 and write release notes with known limitations
Run clean-VM acceptance checklist
Rehearse rollback with the previous ZIP
Tag v1.0.0 and archive artifacts
commands: dotnet publish src/LumenMarkdown.App -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -p:Platform=x64 -p:WindowsPackageType=None -p:WindowsAppSDKSelfContained=true -p:PublishReadyToRun=false -o artifacts/publish/win-x64
verification: ZIP extracts to a path with spaces and launches
First run creates settings and logs under LOCALAPPDATA without admin rights
Open, edit, save, close and reopen work on the clean VM
Uninstall by folder deletion leaves no required residue
SHA-256 matches the published value
README states the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime prerequisite and the SmartScreen warning
phases.exitCriteria: Clean-VM acceptance checklist passes with only the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime installed, and the SHA-256 is published.

userValidationGate.prompt: Run the ZIP on a clean machine, sign the acceptance checklist, and explicitly authorise release.

assumptions.A-1: One document per window is sufficient for v1
assumptions.A-2: WebView2 Evergreen runtime is available on target machines
assumptions.A-5: No telemetry and no auto-update in v1
assumptions.A-6: Lumen Markdown and the placeholder icon are temporary

openPrerequisites: Install SDK 10.0.403 or relax global.json to the installed 10.0.401
Confirm the WinUI 3 unpackaged project template path (Visual Studio or CLI)
Confirm Windows App SDK 2.6.4 restores on this machine
Confirm TextControlBox package identity or plan to vendor its source
Provide a clean Windows 11 x64 VM for Phase 0 and Phase 7
Obtain the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime installer for clean-VM testing
releaseGates: G2 All unit and integration tests green
G3 Smoke script passes on Debug and Release
G5 Accessibility audit has no blockers
G7 No P1 or P2 defects open
